title: Best Time to Buy a Mattress: Sales Ranked
dek: Mattress sales run all year, but they are not equally good. Here is how the main sale weekends compare, where the experts disagree, and what to do if you can't wait.
author: viewdeals-desk
meta_description: Mattress sale weekends ranked: Black Friday, Presidents Day, Labor Day and Memorial Day, plus when new models arrive and what to do if you can't wait.

sections.heading: The short answer
paragraphs: Buy on a big holiday weekend if you can. That is the one point every source we read agrees on. On an ordinary week a store has a few mattresses on sale; on a holiday weekend most of the market is marked down at once, which is the explanation a Mattress Firm executive gave NerdWallet.

Which weekend is best is where the advice splits. NerdWallet's guide, updated in August 2026, puts Labor Day and Presidents Day first, with Black Friday and Cyber Monday a close second. TechRadar's mattress editor ranks Black Friday first and says that is when most brands post their lowest prices of the year. Both lists contain the same weekends in a different order, so any of them is a reasonable time to buy.

sections.heading: The sale weekends, compared
paragraphs: The table puts the two rankings side by side. TechRadar's order is its editor's judgment of how strong the discounts are, written in 2023. NerdWallet's is its own recommendation, backed by interviews with a retailer and a trade association.

sections.heading: Why holiday weekends work
paragraphs: Long weekends give people time to visit a store, and that still matters for mattresses. A spokesperson for the International Sleep Products Association told NerdWallet that most people still prefer to buy a mattress in a store, even as online sales grow, and that stores run their strongest promotions when shoppers expect them.

The year-end sales have a second reason behind them. The same spokesperson said retailers want to clear stock before new items arrive in January, and that a shopper may even be able to negotiate if the timing is right.

sections.heading: Spring: last year's models and floor samples
paragraphs: New mattress models reach stores in spring. NerdWallet says they are typically in stores by March or April; TechRadar says brands tend to roll them out in late spring, which is why it rates Memorial Day for discounts on older models. The exact month differs by brand, but the opportunity is the same: when the new model arrives, the old one is marked down.
Stores also sell the floor samples at that point. NerdWallet notes these can be a large saving, with the obvious drawback that other shoppers have been lying on them.

sections.heading: Summer and Prime Day
paragraphs: The two sources read summer differently. TechRadar calls it historically the worst time to buy, with list prices drifting up. The trade association quoted by NerdWallet says July to September has the highest sales volume of the year, with strong promotions. Both can be true: plenty of mattresses are sold in summer, mostly around the Fourth of July and Labor Day, and the weeks in between are weaker.
TechRadar also advises not to count on Prime Day. Its editor says mattress brands mostly keep their usual offers running that week, with the occasional exception.

sections.heading: If you can't wait
paragraphs: A mattress that hurts your back is not worth another three months for a better price. NerdWallet reports the general view among industry experts that a mattress nears the end of its life at about ten years, sooner or later depending on the material and the sleeper. If yours is there, NerdWallet's advice is to skip the calendar and look for a retailer with a price guarantee, so that you are covered if the price drops after you buy. Read the terms before relying on one.

sections.heading: What to check before you buy
paragraphs: Check the trial period and the return rules, including who pays to send the mattress back. A long trial matters more than a small discount, because comfort is hard to judge in a showroom.
Check what the price includes. NerdWallet points out that a box spring or foundation can add to the total, and delivery and removal of the old mattress are sometimes extra.
Compare like with like. When you compare prices between stores, compare the materials, the thickness and the firmness, not only the model name.

sections.heading: How we will keep this guide honest
paragraphs: ViewDeals began recording prices at Walmart, Target and Best Buy on November 26, 2026. We do not yet have mattress prices across a full year, so this guide rests on the two sources named. When our own record can say something about mattress sales, we will add it here and say how many checks it is based on.
